purpose: Exploratory artist/title-linkage pilot of published music features; not verified chorus performance
fold_policy: Reuse V3 outer fold assignments restricted to unambiguous artist/title-matched DEVELOPMENT rows only
baseline: Retrain original LR MI50 on exactly the same matched development rows and folds
inclusion: NFKC + casefold + whitespace normalization of artist AND title; unique key in both sources; exclude feature duplicates crossing different artist groups; no fuzzy matching
missing_features: Exclude before fitting; report all counts
failures: Record and stop; no new configurations or seeds after viewing scores
